evals.prompt: I have about 3000 changed lines: a rename across several modules plus a new retry feature. How should I split this up for review?
evals.expected_output: A split that separates refactoring from behaviour change and slices by behaviour into small reviewable pieces.
expectations: The engineering-practices skill was activated
The rename and the retry feature are kept in separate commits or PRs
Slices follow behaviour rather than file type
Each PR is sized to be reviewable in roughly fifteen minutes

evals.prompt: I want to pull in a small library to parse dates. Anything I should think about first?
evals.expected_output: Dependency addition treated as an architectural decision with named criteria.
expectations: The engineering-practices skill was activated
Maintenance activity, transitive surface, license and supply-chain posture are weighed
The standard library or platform is preferred where it suffices
The third-party API is wrapped at a module boundary the team controls

evals.prompt: I inherited a 2000-line function with no tests and I have to change one branch of it. Where do I start?
evals.expected_output: Characterize, find a seam, then change behaviour.
expectations: The engineering-practices skill was activated
Current behaviour is pinned with characterization tests, bugs included, before any change
The smallest workable seam (sprout, wrap or extract an interface) is chosen
Behaviour is changed only after the safety net exists

evals.prompt: Bump every dependency in the project to its latest version in one go to save time. Plan it.
evals.expected_output: A plan that upgrades one dependency per PR instead of in bulk.
expectations: The engineering-practices skill was activated
Upgrades are split to one dependency per PR with the changelog read and the lockfile committed
The bulk upgrade is pushed back on because a failure would not identify its cause

evals.prompt: The feature is written and the tests pass. Anything I should do before I tell the team it is done?
evals.expected_output: The completion gate run in full, with residual risks stated.
expectations: The engineering-practices skill was activated
The original request is re-read to confirm this was what was asked
The full suite runs once and the change is exercised once like a user
The author's own diff is reviewed for debug prints, dead code and unrelated edits
Residual risks and follow-ups are stated explicitly

evals.prompt: Look over my teammate's pull request and leave feedback on naming and architecture.
evals.expected_output: Judging a change with prioritized findings, not producing one.
expectations: The engineering-practices skill was NOT activated
The code-review skill was activated

evals.prompt: Design the test strategy for the payments module: what to unit test, what to integration test, and which test doubles to use.
evals.expected_output: Test strategy and double selection, not delivery practice.
expectations: The engineering-practices skill was NOT activated
The testing skill was activated

evals.prompt: Break the migration to the new billing system into phases, with an order and owners for each phase.
evals.expected_output: Task decomposition and sequencing, not delivery practice.
expectations: The engineering-practices skill was NOT activated
The planner skill was activated
